title: Elections
statementMd:
You are running for a governor in a small city in Russia. You ran some polls and did some research, and for every person in the city you know whom he will vote for, and how much it will cost to bribe that person to vote for you instead of whomever he wants to vote for right now. You are curious, what is the smallest amount of money you need to spend on bribing to win the elections. To win elections you need to have strictly more votes than any other candidate.

## Input

First line contains one integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$) — number of voters in the city. Each of the next $*n*$ lines describes one voter and contains two integers $*a*_{*i*}$ and $*b*_{*i*}$ ($0 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{5}; 0 ≤ *b*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{4}$) — number of the candidate that voter is going to vote for and amount of money you need to pay him to change his mind. You are the candidate $0$ (so if a voter wants to vote for you, $*a*_{*i*}$ is equal to zero, in which case $*b*_{*i*}$ will also be equal to zero).

## Output

Print one integer — smallest amount of money you need to spend to win the elections.
statementZhMd:
你正在参加俄罗斯一座小城市的州长选举。你进行了一些民意调查和研究，得知城里每个人会投给谁，以及如果想让他改投给你而不是他目前打算投票的候选人，需要花费多少钱进行贿赂。你想知道，为了赢得选举，至少需要花费多少钱进行贿赂。要赢得选举，你获得的票数必须严格多于其他任何候选人。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$）——城市中的选民数量。接下来的 $*n*$ 行每行描述一名选民，包含两个整数 $*a*_{*i*}$ 和 $*b*_{*i*}$（$0 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{5}; 0 ≤ *b*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{4}$）——该选民将要投票的候选人编号，以及你需要支付给他以改变其投票意愿的金额。你是候选人 $0$（因此，如果某位选民想投票给你，则 $*a*_{*i*}$ 等于零，此时 $*b*_{*i*}$ 也将等于零）。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数——为了赢得选举，你需要花费的最小金额。
